items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you were traveling throughout Cuba with them... With Cascarita - vocalist Orlando Guerra.

ctx.x: But I understand that before you traveled to the United States with them, you were traveling throughout Cuba with them, right?

Ah yes, in Cuba yes. With Cascarita - vocalist Orlando Guerra. He was known by his nickname Cascarita because he was short and thin. We called him Cascarita, but he was very good, very good. After that, Beny Moré then climbed in prominence. After Cascarita.
I have understand that both their styles were a little similar.
